description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions related to memory file management, including reading, hashing, chunking, and multimodal content handling within a larger project.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates a directory recursively if it does not exist.

methods.name: normalizeRelPath
methods.description: Normalizes a relative path by trimming and replacing backslashes with slashes.

methods.name: normalizeExtraMemoryPaths
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes extra memory paths relative to the workspace directory.

methods.name: isMemoryPath
methods.description: Checks if a given relative path is a memory file or directory.

methods.name: isAllowedMemoryFilePath
methods.description: Determines if a file path is allowed based on extension or multimodal classification.

methods.name: listMemoryFiles
methods.description: Lists all memory-related files in the workspace, including optional extra paths.

methods.name: hashText
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash of the input text.

methods.name: buildFileEntry
methods.description: Builds a MemoryFileEntry object from a file, including multimodal content if applicable.

methods.name: loadMultimodalEmbeddingInput
methods.description: Loads embedding input data from a multimodal memory file entry.

methods.name: buildMultimodalChunkForIndexing
methods.description: Creates a MultimodalMemoryChunk for indexing from a memory file entry.

methods.name: chunkMarkdown
methods.description: Splits markdown content into chunks based on token limits and overlap.

methods.name: remapChunkLines
methods.description: Remaps chunk line numbers from content-relative to original source file positions.

methods.name: parseEmbedding
methods.description: Parses a raw string into a numeric embedding array.

methods.name: cosineSimilarity
methods.description: Calculates cosine similarity between two numeric vectors.

methods.name: runWithConcurrency
methods.description: Runs multiple asynchronous tasks with a concurrency limit.
